verse.verse_1: Hallow thou the name of thine Lord, the Most High,
verse.verse_2: Who hath created and then proportioned,
verse.verse_3: And Who hath disposed and then guided,
verse.verse_4: And Who bringeth forth the pasturage,
verse.verse_5: Then maketh it to stubble dusky.
verse.verse_6: We shall enable thee to recite, and then thou shalt not forget,
verse.verse_7: Save that which Allah may will. Verily He knoweth the public and that which is hidden.
verse.verse_8: And We shall make easy Unto thee the easy way.
verse.verse_9: Wherefore admonish thou; admonition hath surely profited,
verse.verse_10: Admonished is he indeed who feareth,
verse.verse_12: He Who shall roast into the Great Fire,
verse.verse_13: Wherein he shall neither die nor live,
verse.verse_14: He indeed hath attained bliss who hath cleansed himself,
verse.verse_15: And who remembereth the name of his Lord, and then prayeth.
verse.verse_16: But ye prefer the life of this world,
verse.verse_17: Whereas the Hereafter is better and more lasting.
verse.verse_18: Verily this is in Writs ancient
